title: Most Christians don’t fall publicly.
paragraphs: Most Christians don’t fall publicly.
They fall in secret.

Late at night.
Behind closed doors.
When no one is watching.
And that’s where the enemy builds his strongest traps.
Many believers love God…
But secretly struggle with thoughts, habits, or temptations they feel too ashamed to talk about.
So today I released a new book called:

📖 The Trap of Secret Temptation
(Spiritual Warfare Series)
This short but powerful book reveals:

• how secret temptation begins
• the enemy’s hidden strategy
• why shame keeps believers trapped
• how to break the cycle of hidden sin
• how Jesus leads us into real freedom

“If the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.”
— John 8:36
